camel_example: aliyun ecs CloneDisks --region cn-hangzhou --Size 60 --DiskCategory cloud_essd --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --MultiAttach Disabled --SourceDiskId 'd-bp1d6tsvznfghy7y0000'
description_en: Clones a cloud disk to quickly create a new cloud disk with the same data as the source disk in the same zone. The cloned cloud disk supports custom capacity, category, and encryption attributes, enabling rapid replication of business data or horizontal scaling of services after being attached to an instance
description_zh: 通过云盘克隆可以快速在同一可用区复制出一块与源盘相同数据的新云盘。克隆出的新云盘支持自定义容量、类型和加密属性，挂载至实例后，可实现业务数据的快速复制或服务的横向扩展
kebab_example: aliyun ecs clone-disks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --source-disk-id d-bp1d6tsvznfghy7y0000 --disk-category cloud_essd --size 60 --multi-attach Disabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloneDisks

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/api-regions-describeregions) operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/api-regions-describeregions)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only perform a dry run for this request. Valid values:
true: sends a check request and does not perform the actual operation. The check items include whether the AccessKey pair is valid, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and whether the required parameters are specified. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): sends a Normal request. If the check succeeds, a 2XX HTTP status code is returned and the actual operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：
true：发送检查请求，不会查询报备单状况。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2XX HTTP状态码并直接查询报备单状况
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. You can generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter only supports ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: The tag key of the cloud disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. If you specify Tag.N.Key, it cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs:, and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 磁盘的标签键。N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入 Tag.N.Key 值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the cloud disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. If you specify Tag.N.Value, it can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 磁盘的标签值。N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入 Tag.N.Value 值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tag information for the cloud disk
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the cloud disk belongs
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘所在的企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source cloud disk
parameters.name: source_disk_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the cloud disk. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters in the Unicode letter category (including English and Chinese characters) and ASCII digits (0-9). It can contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter in the Unicode letter category.

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文等），ASCII数字（0-9）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。必须以Unicode中letter分类下的字符开头。

默认值：空
parameters.name: disk_name

parameters.help_en:
The category of the new cloud disk. Valid values:

cloud_essd: ESSD.
cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL.
cloud_essd_entry: ESSD Entry.
cloud_regional_disk_auto: zone-redundant ESSD.

Limits on cloud disk categories for cloning
Non-zone-redundant cloud disks can only be cloned to non-zone-redundant types.
Zone-redundant cloud disks can only be cloned to zone-redundant types
parameters.help_zh:
新磁盘的磁盘类型。取值范围：

cloud_essd：ESSD 云盘。
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL 云盘。
cloud_essd_entry：ESSD Entry 云盘。
cloud_regional_disk_auto：ESSD 同城冗余云盘。

云盘克隆的磁盘类型限制
非同城冗余类型的云盘，仅能克隆成非同城冗余类型
同城冗余类型的云盘，仅能克隆成同城冗余类型
parameters.name: disk_category

parameters.help_en:
The performance level settings of the cloud disk when you create an ESSD. Valid values:

PL0: A single ESSD can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: A single ESSD can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: A single ESSD can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: A single ESSD can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

If DiskCategory is set to cloud_essd, the PerformanceLevel parameter is required.

For more information about how to select the performance level of an ESSD, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.help_zh:
创建一块ESSD云盘时，设置云盘的性能等级。取值范围：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万。

如果 DiskCategory = cloud_essd，则PerformanceLevel 是必传值

有关如何选择ESSD性能等级，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: performance_level

parameters.help_en:
The capacity of the new cloud disk. Unit: GiB. You must specify a value for this parameter. Valid values:

cloud_essd: The valid values vary based on the performance level.
PL0: 1 to 65,536.
PL1: 20 to 65,536.
PL2: 461 to 65,536.
PL3: 1,261 to 65,536.
cloud_auto: 1 to 65,536.
cloud_essd_entry: 10 to 32,768.
cloud_regional_disk_auto: 10 to 65,536
parameters.help_zh:
新磁盘容量大小。单位：GiB。您必须为该参数传入参数值。取值范围：

cloud_essd：具体取值范围与
    - PL0：1~65,536。
    - PL1：20~65,536。
    - PL2：461~65,536。
    - PL3：1,261~65,536。
cloud_auto：1~65,536。
cloud_essd_entry：10~32,768。
cloud_regional_disk_auto：10~65,536
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the multi-attach feature for the new cloud disk. Valid values:

Disabled: disables the feature.
Enabled: enables the feature. Only ESSDs support this value
parameters.help_zh:
新磁盘是否开启多重挂载特性。取值范围：

Disabled: 不开启。
Enabled : 开启。目前仅 ESSD 云盘支持设置为`Enabled`
parameters.name: multi_attach

parameters.help_en:
The provisioned read and write IOPS for a single ESSD AutoPL. Valid values:
If the capacity is less than or equal to 3 GiB, provisioned performance is not supported.
If the capacity is greater than or equal to 4 GiB, the valid values are 0 to the minimum of (1,000 IOPS/GiB × Capacity - Baseline IOPS) and 50,000.

Baseline performance = the maximum of the minimum of (1,800 + 50 × Capacity) and 50,000, and 3,000.

This parameter is supported only when DiskCategory is set to cloud_auto. For more information, see ESSD AutoPLs (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/user-guide/essd-autopl-disks)
parameters.help_zh:
ESSD AutoPL 云盘（单盘）预配置性能的读写 IOPS。可能值：
容量（GiB）<=3：不支持设置预配置性能。
容量（GiB）>=4：[0，min{(1,000
IOPS/GiB*容量-基准 IOPS)，50,000}]

基准性能=max{min{1,800+50*容量，50,000}, 3,000}。

当DiskCategory = cloud_auto时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见 ESSD AutoPL 云盘 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/user-guide/essd-autopl-disks)
parameters.name: provisioned_iops

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable performance bursting for the new cloud disk. Valid values:
true: enables performance bursting.
false: disables performance bursting.
This parameter is supported only when DiskCategory is set to cloud_auto. For more information, see ESSD AutoPLs (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/user-guide/essd-autopl-disks)
parameters.help_zh:
新磁盘是否开启 Burst（性能突发）。取值范围：
true：是。
false：否。
当DiskCategory = cloud_auto时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见 ESSD AutoPL 云盘 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/user-guide/essd-autopl-disks)
parameters.name: bursting_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the new cloud disk is encrypted. Valid values:
true: The cloud disk is encrypted.
false: The cloud disk is not encrypted.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
新磁盘是否是加密云盘。取值范围：
true：是。
false：否。

默认值：false
parameters.name: encrypted

parameters.help_en: The KMS key ID used by the new cloud disk
parameters.help_zh: 新磁盘使用的 KMS 密钥 ID
parameters.name: kms_key_id

TaskGroupId.description_en: The ID of the task group for cloud disk cloning. You can call the DescribeTasks (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/developer-reference/api-ecs-2014-05-26-describetasks) operation to query the task execution result
TaskGroupId.description_zh: 云盘克隆的任务组 ID，您可以通过 DescribeTasks (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/developer-reference/api-ecs-2014-05-26-describetasks) 查询任务执行结果
